benchmark: SAP Payment Saga deterministic fault campaign v1

generator.name: CounterMix64V1
generator.semantics: field-domain-separated SplitMix64 finalizer; stateless counter derivation
generator.equation: mix64(root_seed XOR (sequence * sequence_multiplier mod 2^64) XOR (field_domain * field_domain_multiplier mod 2^64))

value_bounds.lost_commit_ack_mask: bit 0 local; bit 1 Treasury; Treasury bit cleared when fee=0

trace_semantics.local_transaction: One sender-owned atomic source-chain transaction containing debit, recipient credit, Payment, Receipt and Treasury outbox intent.
trace_semantics.treasury_fee: A separately owned effect dependent on committed local payment; same stable effect ID on retry.
trace_semantics.retry_semantics: Indeterminate followed by same-effect prepare; no new operation or effect identity.
trace_semantics.lost_ack_semantics: A commit is recorded, acknowledgement loss is injected, then the same committed effect is observed/replayed with the exact same evidence.
trace_semantics.replay: Replay the complete anchored append-only event stream and require operation/effect state parity with the live reference reducer.
trace_semantics.independent_oracle: Integer minor-unit conservation: sender debit = recipient principal credit + separately committed Treasury fee.

explicit_coverage: zero-fee path with no Treasury effect
anchored replay reconstructs final operation state
excluded_from_v1: Holochain conductor multi-agent concurrency and fork resolution
provider-specific key retention and region failover
database crash, fsync, lease fencing and process-kill injection

metrics.name: Replay projection parity

metrics.name: Integer-unit conservation
metrics.target: 0 unexplained minor-unit delta in every generated trace
